newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian PM to make petrol announcement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian PM to make petrol announcement.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard would announce changes to the petrol pricing regime in a bid to make the industry more competitive, Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday.
"The Prime Minister will announce in the House (of Representatives) today important new changes in relation to petrol pricing," Costello told reporters.
"This is going to be a major structural improvement and it's directed at delivering to benefits to motorists, benefits from economic reforms."
Costello declined to reveal what the changes would be, saying only that the reforms would promote open access, new players and new sources of supply.

"What we think is that by ensuring open access to oil terminals in a competitive regime ... that we can get competitive forces ensuring that consumers get a better deal in relation to petrol pricing," he said.
A report in The Daily Telegraph newspaper said on Wednesday the government would remove price controls from next year.
It was also considering removing restrictions on how many petrol stations are allowed to open, the newspaper reported.
